reason: It's free during the pilot, so I'd try one matched creator to see if the promo code actually shows me bookings instead of just views. After the pilot, I'd mostly find creators myself on Instagram like I do now and skip the fee.
objection: I already DM creators and pay them by UPI myself. Once the pilot ends, 10% plus GST on top of the creator's fee is money I don't see the point of paying when my margins are already thin, and I'm not sure my staff will remember to tap +1 at the front desk.
would_change_my_mind: If the first matched creator brings in more bookings per rupee than the ones I find myself, with the codes as proof, I'd pay the fee for future deals.
